data.name: Jaffar
data.gender_notes: Jaffar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jaffar is derived from the Arabic root word 'Afr' which means 'to be pure or free from'. In Islamic history, Jaffar ibn Abi Talib was a companion and cousin of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He was one of the ten promised Paradise and was known for his unwavering loyalty and devotion. The name Jaffar carries the meaning “Friend, companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaffar usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes companionship and loyalty in the path of faith.
data.etymology: Jaffar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaffar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: جعفر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جعفر يعني النهر الجاري أو الينبوع
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جعفر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه النهر الجاري أو الينبوع الذي يتدفق منه الماء، وقد ورد ذكره في بعض الأحاديث النبوية وله أهمية في التراث الإسلامي كونه اسم أحد الصحابة الأبرار وهو جعفر بن أبي طالب الذي كان معروفا بكرمه وشجاعته في معركة مؤتة.

in_urdu.name: جعفر
in_urdu.meaning: نام جعفر کا مطلب ہے چلتا ہوا چشمہ یا ندی
in_urdu.long_meaning: جعفر ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے چلتا ہوا چشمہ یا ندی۔ یہ نام جعفر بن ابی طالب کے نام سے مشہور ہے، جو رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ وسلم کے صحابی تھے اور مؤتہ کی جنگ میں اپنی شجاعت کے لئے جانے جاتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: जाफ़र
in_hindi.meaning: जाफ़र का अर्थ है बहता हुआ स्रोत या नदी
in_hindi.long_meaning: जाफ़र एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है बहता हुआ स्रोत या नदी। यह नाम जाफ़र इब्न अबी तालिब के नाम से प्रसिद्ध है, जो पैगंबर मुहम्मद के सहाबा थे और मोउता की लड़ाई में अपनी वीरता के लिए जाने जाते थे।

in_english.name: Jaffar
in_english.meaning: Jaffar means a flowing fountain or river in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Jaffar is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'a flowing fountain or river.' It is derived from the Arabic root 'j-f-r,' which signifies 'to gush forth' or 'to flow.' The name holds significant historical and spiritual importance as it was borne by Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and a notable figure in Islamic history known for his valor in the Battle of Mu'tah.

Today, Jaffar is a common Islamic name that reflects the historical legacy and cultural heritage of Muslims.

historical_references.reference: Jaffar ibn Abi Talib was the cousin, companion and close confidant of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). He was a key figure during the Ridda Wars (632-633 AD), supporting the Prophet and helping establish Islam in various Arabian regions.
Jaffar ibn Ali, known as Imam Jaffar as-Sadiq, was the sixth Imam of the Shia Muslims. He ruled from 765 to 795 AD and is considered a major authority in Shia Islam, especially in Hadith and Fiqh.
